comment: Template families bundle shell-nav variant + shell-footer variant + base typography scale + per-page layout overrides into a coherent design system. Pure data; v2 deterministic compose still applies. Six families: classic-business, editorial-statement, directory-rich, simple-statement, event-led and editorial-sanctuary (a Sanctuary palette with italic Cormorant typography for healer/coach/therapist sites that need to read truly high-end). The plan they came from is docs/internals/CAS_V2_TEMPLATE_FAMILIES_PLAN.md.

templates.name: Classic Business
templates.summary: Balanced multi-page layout with traditional top nav and three-column footer. The default; suits any archetype.
templates.thumbnail_alt_summary: Balanced multi-page layout with a top bar nav, medium display headlines, and a three-column footer.

templates.name: Editorial Statement
templates.summary: Magazine-feeling site with thin minimal nav, oversized display headlines, very airy spacing, and a single-rule footer. Suits authors, coaches, healers, therapists who value typography over chrome.
templates.thumbnail_alt_summary: Magazine-feeling layout with a thin minimal nav, oversized display headlines, very airy spacing, and low chrome density.

templates.name: Directory Rich
templates.summary: Information-dense layout with a persistent left rail nav (lg+) and a full-sitemap footer. Suits multi-location, multi-service businesses where customers come back to find the right service or location.
templates.thumbnail_alt_summary: Information-dense layout with a persistent left sidebar rail, compact headlines, and a full-sitemap footer.

templates.name: Simple Statement
templates.summary: One-page focus with oversized type, no logo, and a single-line footer. For solo practitioners who want one big idea per page and minimal chrome.
templates.thumbnail_alt_summary: One-page focus with three centered nav links, very large display headlines, and almost no chrome.

templates.name: Event Led
templates.summary: Image-banner nav strip across the top with hero photo, plus the classic three-column footer. Suits event producers, classes, and gatherings where dates and the visual hook are the offer.
templates.thumbnail_alt_summary: Image-banner hero across the top with nav overlaid, bold headlines, and medium chrome density.

templates.name: Editorial Sanctuary
templates.summary: Paper-cream sanctuary with deep-teal ink, sage + warm-gold accents, and italic Cormorant Garamond for every display heading. Suits healers, coaches, and therapists whose sites need to read like a quiet print piece, not a tech product.
templates.thumbnail_alt_summary: Paper-cream sanctuary layout with sage and warm-gold accents, italic serif display headlines, and quiet, low chrome density.
templates.extra_body_css: body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary { background-color: var(--color-background); } body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary h1, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary h2, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary h3, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary h4, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary h5, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary h6 { font-style: italic; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.05; color: var(--color-foreground); } body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-eyebrow, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .eyebrow, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-eye { font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: none; color: var(--color-foreground-muted); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; } body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-eyebrow::before, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .eyebrow::before, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-eye::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: var(--color-accent-earth); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent-earth) 22%, transparent); flex-shrink: 0; } body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-paper-card, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .resource-card, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .family-card { background-color: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; } body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-paper-card:hover, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .resource-card:hover, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .family-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -18px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary) 30%, transparent); } body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-cta-strip { background-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); padding: 4rem 2rem; text-align: center; } body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-cta-strip h2, body.cas-template-editorial-sanctuary .cas-cta-strip h3 { color: var(--color-on-primary); }
